messages:
marisa: Heads-up — we're seeing a couple of customers get 413s from the embeddings endpoint.

marisa: Example from prod logs:\n```json\n{\"error\":\"Payload too large\",\"code\":413,\"bytes\":1250000}\n```\n
marisa: Looks like router preflight rejects before the splitter can run. Customers expect automatic chunking, console shows max_payload_bytes=1MB but router rejects at 900KB for some routes.

chen: ugh, variants of this have bitten us before. is the router checking serialized.size vs original bytes? might be double-encoding somewhere.

owen: Router currently enforces MaxRequestBytes based on header X-Payload-Bytes when present, else Content-Length. If clients gzip or send ndjson we can get mismatches.

chen: Suggestion: add a defensive preflight that computes effective_payload_bytes after decompression and content-type parsing, then call the splitter. Failing fast on raw Content-Length is causing bad UX.

samir: We also need telemetry: histograms for preflight_bytes, postparse_bytes, split_chunks_created, and count of 413_by_stage (router/preflight/splitter/server). Without that it's hard to correlate console traces to customer reports.

devex-bot: Filed INF-234: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-234 — "embeds: normalize payload byte accounting + console toggle for max_payload_bytes". Assigned to @chen.

chen: I'll sketch a change: (1) normalize bytes after parsing, (2) let splitter run if normalized_bytes > route.max_payload_bytes && route.allow_auto_split, (3) emit 413 only if normalized_bytes > route.max_allowed_post_split_bytes (safety cap).

owen: Edge case: mixed-dimension arrays. If we split by bytes we might create chunks with inconsistent dims that the sharder can't serve. Need a per-model "split_by": ["bytes","count","dim_consistent"] policy.

marisa: Good call. Product wants a console UX: route-level toggle "auto-split embeddings" + slider for max chunk size and an advanced dropdown for split strategy (bytes/count/dims). Also show telemetry panel (pre/post bytes, chunking rate, 413 rate).

samir: Rollout plan: canary 5% of traffic on dedicated infra with new preflight+splitter, monitor 413_by_stage drop, chunk-induced latency p95, and quality regressions (we already have embedding-sim evals). If stable 24h -> 25% -> full.

owen: Need router fallback policy too: if splitter fails or dims-incompatible, route to a compatible fallback model/version rather than just 413.

marisa: Agreed. For console change, @devex-bot can you prepare copy and a mock? We should show the impact in the per-route cost view (chunking increases token counts).

devex-bot: Will do. Mock ETA EOD tomorrow. Will include tooltip: "Auto-split may increase requests and tokens billed; lowers chance of 413s." :info:

chen: I'll open a PR for the preflight normalization + metrics. Quick prototype in the router: compute normalized_bytes := bytes_after_decompression(content), emit metric routing.preflight.normalized_bytes and routing.preflight.stage(\"router\"/\"postparse\").

samir: For canary, add a rollout guard that auto-rolls back if 413_by_stage(router)+413_by_stage(postparse) > 0.1% over baseline or chunking_latency_p95 > baseline*2.

marisa: Thanks all. New action items: chen -> proto + PR, devex -> console mock + copy, owen -> split strategy policy doc, samir -> canary runbook and telemetry alerts. I'll create a short channel update once PR lands.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing/preflight-normalize v0.1-canary -> infra-dedicated-3

chen: pushed initial prototype branch, linking in INF-234 comments.

marisa: thanks, let's iterate. :thumbsup:
